description: This file contains an asynchronous JavaScript module for handling event dispatching, AJAX requests, and dynamic iframe content loading within the revive-adserver project. It includes custom event creation, URL encoding, and DOM manipulation specific to ad zone management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the ad zone event handlers, AJAX setup, and iframe content loading.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes an object into URL query parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Triggers AJAX request for ad zones if zones are defined.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects ad zone elements in the DOM and assigns zone IDs and attributes.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates an iframe element with specified dimensions.

methods.name: loadFrame
methods.description: Loads HTML content into an iframe element.

methods.name: spc
methods.description: Processes received ad zone data, updating DOM elements accordingly.

methods.name: getDataAttr
methods.description: Constructs data attribute names based on the module's naming convention.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Generates custom event names based on the module's naming scheme.
